steps.en: OCMS reports the records processed by the agency
steps.id: OCMS melaporkan record yang diproses agency
steps.why_en: The report is general, not about warrant defendants or new addresses.
steps.why_id: Report-nya umum, bukan soal defendant warrant atau alamat baru.

steps.why_en: The error report is general, not about warrant defendants.
steps.why_id: Report error-nya umum, bukan soal defendant warrant.

steps.en: The OIC sees the report on a dashboard
steps.why_en: Reports go out by email, not to an OIC dashboard.
steps.why_id: Report dikirim lewat email, bukan ke dashboard OIC.
